content.description:
Pups of Anarchy (POA) is a collection of unique Pup NFTs. The POA NFTs are your membership card to the VIP areas in various metaverse worlds and experiences. Each pup is designed with unique traits making some pups rarer than others. We are building out in several Metaverses to create games with rewards and community events to continuously give back to the Pups of Anarchy community.

We have built out a huge roadmap that is focused on delivering great art and value to our community every step of the way. And finally we want people to have fun while raising the roof as we all head to the moon.
